classes.end: Installing, uninstall leaves ~/.local/state/jstack behind: No expert yet
classes.rule: Every path jstack made is recorded or not made: an uninstall leaves nothing behind.
classes.cause: the install makes jstack's state folder before a record names it

classes.end: Nothing of jstack's on disk: Expert in thread 2 starting, two webhooks live
classes.rule: An expert has at most one live webhook, and once a start has ended, its record names it and the thread it posts into.
classes.cause: the new thread keeps no record of the webhook the last one made and never kept

classes.end: Nothing of jstack's on disk: Expert in thread 1, its webhook kept, posting into thread 1, its address lost
classes.rule: Once a start has ended, the address kept is the kept webhook's.
classes.cause: the turn stopped before it kept the address, and nothing writes it again

classes.end: Nothing of jstack's on disk: Expert in thread 1, a webhook no record names, its address lost
classes.rule: An expert has at most one live webhook, and once a start has ended, its record names it and the thread it posts into.
classes.cause: the turn stopped before it kept the webhook it made
